label: Operator
definition: Runs the mechanism and sets the terms participants deal under. For a balancing or flexibility service this is the buyer (NESO or a DNO); for an exchange market it is the exchange; for a regulated regime it is the body that administers it.

label: Delivery body
definition: The body that legislation makes responsible for running a government scheme's allocation: registering applicants, checking eligibility and holding the auction or allocation round.

label: Policy owner
definition: The government department that sets the policy and legal framework for the mechanism.

label: Counterparty or settlement body
definition: Holds the contracts or obligations with scheme participants and makes or collects the scheme payments, for example the CfD counterparty or the Capacity Market Settlement Body.

label: Settlement agent
definition: Calculates and administers settlement on behalf of a scheme's counterparty or settlement body.

label: Regulator (named role)
definition: A regulator with a specific role in the mechanism's own rules, such as hearing appeals or amending rules. Not recorded just because the operator holds a licence.

label: Market platform
definition: Runs the IT system on which participants register, pre-qualify, submit bids or orders and receive results. The system is named in platform_code where it has its own name.

label: Dispatch platform
definition: Runs the IT system through which the buyer sends instructions to contracted providers and receives the availability, metering or performance data used for settlement.
